lines.en: Grit crumbles off my shoulder.
My tread could crush a plank.
I drag one thick leg after the other.
Branches snap back behind me.
I work around the camp's outer ring.
My fists hang low, knuckles brushing grass.
Mud squeezes between my toes.
I kick a stone out of the way.

lines.zh: 走近城墙，影子压住垛口
lines.en: Near the wall, my shadow covers the merlons.
Not fast, not slow.
The moss on me shifts with each step.
I lift my head and sniff the air.
I sit on a rock like a small hill.
I scratch my jaw with a knuckle.
I shrug and pebbles fall off.
I pick a bone out from between my teeth.
Cracks run through my stone hide.
I hum two low notes.
Birds hop about near my feet.

lines.zh: 我一下也没动，鸟也不怕
lines.en: I don't move, and the birds don't fear me.
I squint at the sun.
Voices come from the camp.
I scratch the moss on my back.
I let out one long breath.
I rest my fists on my knees.
I've watched this ground a long while.
Stone doesn't tire. I do.
But I can still sit.
I look down, brow heavy.

lines.zh: 你这么小，一站就到我跟前
lines.en: So small. One stride and you're here.

lines.zh: 我的拳头比你的整个身子粗。
lines.en: My fist is thicker than you are.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味我不喜欢
lines.en: I don't like the iron smell on you.
My nostrils puff.
The camp folk call me troll.
I hold the wall for them.
And I fight for them.
To enter, you ask them.
As a troll, I only know a few words.
But I understand it all.

lines.zh: 巨魔的营地，人类别进来。
lines.en: This troll camp is no place for humans.
The finger is thicker than your arm.
That's my only warning.
It stings. Stone doesn't mind.
A crack opened on this side.
I rock back half a step and settle.
Chips of stone fall off me.
That one had weight.
I roll my shoulder.
I growl low and the dirt shakes under me.
You put some strength in that.
I'll remember that.

lines.zh: 这一下连我的皮都没破。
lines.en: That did not even break my hide.
What's that? Can I eat it?
I crouch down and lean in.
Smells like stone that's been baked.
I slowly part my jaws.
Too small. One bite and it's gone.
Do you have more on you?

lines.zh: 这么点东西，一根手指就够。
lines.en: A morsel that small needs one finger.
A bit too hard.
It crumbled. I'm disappointed.
Never mind. I'll eat stone.
You hit my leg and bounce off.
I don't shift a step.
My stone hide is hard.
I look down, a little surprised.
Are you still standing?

lines.zh: 我抬手想扶你，又放下了
lines.en: I reach to steady you, then stop.
My hands are too heavy.
That force is nothing.
You crash into me and barely reach my knee.
Go on through.
Trolls have companions too.
She lives in farther hills.
A nest of stones. Very solid.
I once brought her a whole tree.
She said I carried it too loudly.
So I learned to set things down gently.
Her laugh makes the stones ring.
I haven't been back in a long while.
Once this wall is held.
I head back.
I scoop it up in one whole hand.
I squeeze it. Too soft.
Into the hide bag at my waist.
Will this trade for drink?
I hold it up to look.
Can't see it. Too close to my eyes.
I set it down again.
Too small for me to hold.
Never mind. Take it.
I only carry big things.
I'm standing up.
The trees sway when I rise.
I close my fists.
Grit falls from the backs of my hands.
The camp is shouting.

lines.zh: 我朝他们那边挡了一步
lines.en: I step to shield them.
To pass, you go through me.
Head low, I bear down.
My steps leave craters.
I don't roar. I walk.
This step is slow.
The next one won't be.
I turn as you turn.
Slow, but I don't stop.

lines.zh: 你绕到树后，树挡不住我
lines.en: Behind a tree? Trees don't stop me.
I break the tree in half.
A line of deep prints follows me.

lines.zh: 我一步一步跟，地都在响。
lines.en: I follow step by step, and the ground rings.
You're quicker than me. I know.
But you have to rest.
I never do.
Every stop you take, I gain a step.
The wall blocks your right.
I have the left.
Only forward is left.
And forward is me.
That suits me fine.
I smash down and the ground splits.
The blow shoves you back.
My palm sweeps like a gust.
I slam with my shoulder.
My toe kicks up a stone.
I lift you and set you back down.

lines.zh: 我的拳头带着风声砸下去。
lines.en: My fist comes down with the wind behind it.

lines.zh: 你举盾的手被我压弯了。
lines.en: The arm holding your shield bends under mine.
My fist sinks into the dirt.

lines.zh: 拔出来的时候带了一堆土
lines.en: It comes out with a heap of soil.
I don't chase. You can still retreat.
Keep this up and you'll break.

lines.zh: 营地边上多了一座石头堆
lines.en: A heap of stone appears at the camp's edge.
The heap stands up.
A layer of moss sloughs off me.
I crack my neck.
Someone at the wall is watching.
I raise a hand in greeting.
They didn't run. Good.
This wall has a gap.
I'll stand in it.
I plant my feet in the soil.
A horn sounds far off.
I look that way.
Looks like a fight.
Then we fight.
Fire blisters a layer off my stone.
I land in a crouch.
In water I sink faster than stone.
The blast strips moss off one side.

lines.zh: 箭扎在石皮上，掉了一半
lines.en: The arrow sticks in my hide, half buried.
This force crawls into the cracks.
Hunger dulls my stone hide.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我身上，震得发麻
lines.en: Lightning hits me and I go numb.

lines.zh: 脚下的土碎了，我往下掉
lines.en: The soil crumbles. I fall.
